name: Seung L. Yang
tagline: Top rated Employment Litigation attorney in Los Angeles, California
side_practice_areas: Employment Litigation, Civil Rights, Employment & Labor
about: In the bustling city of Los Angeles, California, Seung L. Yang stands as a beacon of justice at The Sentinel Firm, APC. With nearly two decades of legal competence, he has carved out a reputation as a formidable advocate for employees and accident victims seeking justice. His journey in law is driven by a profound commitment to making a difference in the lives of those who have been wronged.

Mr. Yang's passion for defending workers' rights was ignited early in his career when he co-founded one of California's largest plaintiff employment law firms. In this capacity, he ardently represented countless employees, particularly those in low-wage positions, in cases of discrimination, harassment, retaliation and wrongful termination. His relentless pursuit of justice has resulted in securing hundreds of millions of dollars in compensation for these individuals, ensuring their voices are heard and their rights upheld.

A true consummate professional, Mr. Yang's legal career is marked by a dedication to championing the rights of workers and accident victims alike. His decision to establish The Sentinel Firm, APC, was fueled by a desire to broaden his impact and provide comprehensive legal support to those in need. By merging his deep understanding of employment law with personal injury litigation, he offers a compassionate and thorough approach to legal representation.

An academic scholar, Mr. Yang's journey began at the University of California, San Diego, where he earned a B.A. in political science. He then honed his legal acumen at Loyola Law School, Los Angeles, graduating in 2006 and began practicing law in California the following year. His credentials extend to the United States District Courts for the Northern, Eastern, Central and Southern Districts of California.

In recognition of his outstanding advocacy, Mr. Yang was honored as one of the Top 100 Trial Lawyers in California by the National Trial Lawyers in 2023. His dedication to his clients and his craft is further reflected in his "Good" rating on Avvo, underscoring his commitment to excellence and justice.
